metadata.title: Sentinel tailored baseline: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5

values: Leafnode subject permissions: an edge never exports unit.>, passes.> or node.> to its hub and never imports node.>; console events are published only on node-scoped subjects (node.<id>.>); requests leave a node for a hosted AI service only with an UNCLASSIFIED marking, operator opt-in and a usable measured link.
Signing operator decision-log entries; hashing assessment inputs, audit records and release files; protecting console sessions (TLS) and administrative sessions (SSH).
Ed25519 signatures; SHA-256; TLS as negotiated by Caddy; SSH restricted to the DISA STIG's FIPS 140-3 approved ciphers, MACs and key exchange algorithms.
Conjunction Data Messages (CCSDS 508.0-B-1 KVN) submitted for ingest or fetched from a hub; decision-log entries received from peer nodes; operator questions to the assistant.

The AI assistant's narrated answers, whose numbers must each appear, at the stated precision, in the tool results or the operator's question; and every probability of collision the API or console shows, which must carry its method.

Loss or degradation of the link to the hub (DENIED, DEGRADED, INTERMITTENT, LIMITED); a hosted AI service failing or unreachable; conjunction inputs outside the 2D Pc method's validity (low relative velocity, curvilinear uncertainty, absent or non-positive-definite covariance).

The node keeps serving its console and recording signed decisions on local data, and reconciles when the link returns; the assistant falls back to its local router and templates within the same answer and says so; the risk engine returns REFUSED with the reason and the value that tripped the gate instead of a Pc.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Operators record decisions that must be attributable, and administrators hold root on nodes.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A public node must refuse writes, and replicas must accept decisions only from trusted nodes.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A ground unit's position and its pass windows must never leave the edge that holds them, and nothing leaves a node for a hosted AI service unless policy allows it.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The AI layer must have no path to the maths, and the service and hub need no more privilege than they use.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Administrators reach nodes remotely; the path must be narrow and strongly protected. The STIG's SSH rules map here (DISA CCI list).

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Decisions, AI interactions and rejected input must be reconstructable after the fact.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A decision record is useful only if it says who, what, when, where and against which data.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Tamper evidence is worth little unless someone checks it and acts on what it shows.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The decision log is the record of what operators decided; it must be tamper-evident on every node.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Signed decisions: a decision cannot later be disowned or attributed to another node.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Evidence is regenerated on every change, not collected once for an assessment.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A node installs identically in the cloud, at the edge and in an air-gapped enclave only if its baseline is code.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A change to the engine or the sync layer changes what operators are told; it must be tested and traceable.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Vendor defaults assumed a LAN and would have broken a satellite-linked edge; settings must be deliberate and documented.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A field node should do one job; everything else is attack surface.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: An air-gapped enclave must know exactly what it installed.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A node must refuse to install software it cannot attribute to its publisher.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Decisions are attributed to people; today the node takes the proxy's word for who they are.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Node signing keys and administrator keys are the authenticators everything else trusts.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Dependencies and host configuration drift; both must be scanned, and findings must land in the POA&M.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The evidence is only as good as the control over the code and data it came from.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The risk engine's numbers decide whether propellant is spent; they must be proven against an independent reference.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The process that produces the code is part of the evidence.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The hub faces the internet; edges face contested links.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Console sessions cross the internet and the edge link crosses contested networks.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Signatures are only as trustworthy as the way keys are made and distributed.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Signatures and hashes carry the integrity claims; the algorithms and modules must be named.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Edges are deployed where hardware can be lost; the hub holds every node's replicated decisions.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Flaws found by tests, scans and updates must be tracked to closure.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: At the edge, knowing the state of the link is part of knowing the state of the system.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Verify before install, verify before merge: nothing is trusted because of where it came from.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The engine's answer is only as good as its input: a CDM in the wrong units or frame produces a confident, wrong Pc.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: A language model may phrase an answer; it must not be able to put an unsupported number in front of an operator.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The two failures Sentinel is built for are losing the link and receiving input the method cannot handle; in both it must fail to a known, honest state.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: The same bundle installs in an air-gapped enclave; everything in it must be pinned and checked.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Every number Sentinel shows traces to its inputs; every input should trace to its origin.

props.name: tailoring-rationale
props.value: Counterfeit or tampered components must be refused before they run.
